Confidence intervals for
squared semipartial correlation coefficients
and Cohen's f-squared
are generated using
the `SCorSqNB()` and `FSqNB()` functions from the `betaNB` package.
In this example,
we use the data set and the model used in
[betaNB: Example Using the BetaNB Function](example-beta-nb.html).


``` r
library(betaNB)
```




``` r
df <- betaNB::nas1982
```

### Regression

Fit the regression model using the `lm()` function.


``` r
object <- lm(QUALITY ~ NARTIC + PCTGRT + PCTSUPP, data = df)
```

### Nonparametric Bootstrap


``` r
nb <- NB(object)
```

### Squared Semipartial Correlation Coefficients

The semipartial correlation is signed,
and its interval may contain zero.
`SCorSqNB()` returns the image of the signed interval under squaring.
It is not the interval of squared draws.


``` r
SCorSqNB(nb, level = 0.95, type = "pc")
#>               est       lower     upper
#> NARTIC  0.1858925 0.083081945 0.3155848
#> PCTGRT  0.1176542 0.036622978 0.2269816
#> PCTSUPP 0.0568722 0.009068478 0.1403405
```


``` r
SCorSqNB(nb, level = 0.95, type = "bca")
#>               est      lower     upper
#> NARTIC  0.1858925 0.09745129 0.3392660
#> PCTGRT  0.1176542 0.04653313 0.2594900
#> PCTSUPP 0.0568722 0.01017202 0.1450065
```

### Cohen's f-Squared


``` r
out <- FSqNB(nb, alpha = 0.05)
```

## Methods

### summary


``` r
summary(out, type = "pc")
#> Call:
#> FSqNB(object = nb, alpha = 0.05)
#> 
#> Cohen's f-squared (fsq) and local f-squared
#> type = "pc"
#>            est     se    R   2.5%  97.5%
#> fsq     4.1158 1.6336 5000 2.2707 8.4820
#> NARTIC  0.9510 0.4208 5000 0.3909 2.0170
#> PCTGRT  0.6019 0.3082 5000 0.1882 1.3494
#> PCTSUPP 0.2909 0.2215 5000 0.0442 0.9040
```

### coef


``` r
coef(out)
#>       fsq    NARTIC    PCTGRT   PCTSUPP 
#> 4.1157764 0.9509843 0.6018924 0.2909455
```

### vcov


``` r
vcov(out)
#>               fsq     NARTIC      PCTGRT     PCTSUPP
#> fsq     2.6686351 0.40550731 0.223492014 0.167803760
#> NARTIC  0.4055073 0.17704313 0.024749768 0.016998484
#> PCTGRT  0.2234920 0.02474977 0.095002194 0.007515373
#> PCTSUPP 0.1678038 0.01699848 0.007515373 0.049044184
```

### confint


``` r
confint(out, level = 0.95, type = "pc")
#>              2.5 %   97.5 %
#> fsq     2.27074679 8.482015
#> NARTIC  0.39090998 2.017013
#> PCTGRT  0.18820538 1.349436
#> PCTSUPP 0.04416856 0.904010
```
